scope: Independent ETF long/cash studies; no portfolio, options, RL or live execution
primary_metric: Net daily Sharpe with zero cash/risk-free rate, matched dates and 5 bps actual-turnover costs
experiment_rules: All pre-2024 history is exploratory and has been inspected in prior research. No new untouched-out-of-sample claim is made.
The v2 year-specific target, horizon, base features and sizing remain fixed in the three primary ablations unless the variant explicitly changes one of them.
Every variant is predeclared. Display every result and preserve original v2 files; never promote a family or recipe using historical comparison results.
Reserved prices are removed before any feature or label computation. No 2024+ fitting, calibration, forecasts, strategy scoring or hypothesis selection.

Calibration uses expanding chronological OOF predictions and only outcomes matured before the outer cutoff. The calibration candidate spec was selected using earlier validation data, so OOF calibration is not an untouched performance estimate.
There is no optimization over the variants. Their historical comparisons generate hypotheses for later validation.

variants.baseline: Exact v2 CART selected signal/sizing; replay verifies identical original net NAV
variants.payoff_only: Same base model; prior OOF prediction bins mapped to shrunk expected net payoff; LONG iff expected net payoff > 0
variants.context_only: Append the ETF-specific context pack, same CART/target/horizon/sizing; use original signal threshold
variants.payoff_context: Combined context and prior OOF expected-payoff mapping; interaction experiment, separately reported
variants.payoff_buffer: Payoff-only signal with hysteresis: enter expected net payoff > 0.001; exit < -0.001; otherwise retain prior signal
variants.weekly_target: Same model/feature/sizing family; replace horizon label with next weekly execution-open to following weekly execution-open net return
variants.risk_scaled_target: CART regression on net horizon return divided by decision-known 63-session volatility*sqrt(horizon/252), volatility floor 5%; map predictions back to return units
variants.recency_weighted: Same baseline CART and target; exponential training weights with fixed 3 calendar-year half-life
variants.quarterly_refit: Yearly baseline spec frozen; refit same CART at Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct cutoffs with only prior matured labels
variants.ewma_vol: Same baseline signal, 10% target using EWMA daily squared returns lambda=0.94; also compare with original CART_vol baseline
variants.turnover_buffer: Same baseline forecasts: classifier enter>0.55/exit<0.45; regression enter>0.001/exit<-0.001; otherwise retain signal; same yearly v2 sizing
variants.trend_10m_fixed: LONG when last calendar-completed monthly close exceeds trailing 10-month SMA; otherwise cash; fixed 100% exposure
variants.trend_10m_vol: Same 10-month rule with causal 63-session 10% volatility target
variants.tsmom12m_fixed: LONG when own 252-session adjusted-price return>0; otherwise cash; fixed 100% exposure
variants.tsmom12m_vol: Same 252-session sign rule with causal 63-session 10% volatility target
variants.fixed_recipe_cart: Fixed 10-session technical-only CART classifier depth3/minleaf0.08/seed42, annual expanding refit, 0.5 signal and 10% volatility sizing

calibration.fallback: Preserve uncalibrated signal and flag insufficient matured OOF history
calibration.uncertainty: Outcome standard deviation is descriptive, with dependent/overlapping observations; no naive independent-sample confidence claim

missingness: ETF context uses zero value plus explicit availability flag; no prices filled. Static duplicate correlation aliases are removed when already supplied by base recipe.
multiplicity: Joint paired 500-replicate 20-session moving-block bootstrap per ETF; raw delta-Sharpe intervals and approximate one-sided centered-bootstrap p values, Holm adjusted across all 225 nonbaseline arm/ETF comparisons. Does not rerun the complete selection/fit process or account for all prior research.
controls: Always-long ETF buy/hold, always-long 10% volatility target, and existing CART fixed/vol variants remain visible. Model selection does not use these new outer results.
